about: Regions of the concept painting (1920x1080 = src/typel/render/keyart.json space) that each plate edit is allowed to change. Used by tools/assets/prep.py composite. Rectangles are [x0, y0, x1, y1].

PLT-001.label: Sky: word scrolls and their effects, flying scroll, Grand Wizard (title cartouche excluded)

PLT-002.label: Score engine: drum digits, plates, level plate, medals

PLT-003.label: Typewriter and desk: paper text and hammer, hands, key letters, note, gauge needle

PLT-004.label: Shelf: the eight rolled scrolls and counts

PLT-005.label: Title removed from the top of the arch

PLT-006.label: Shorter shelf, TYPEL title above, blank stage banner

PLT-007.label: Rune conveyor display; medal tray removed

PLT-008.label: Typewriter spell keys and Ward orb; pipe replaces gauge

build_note: Later regions win where they overlap. PLT-003 first so the sky edit (PLT-001) cleans the stamp area above the paper; PLT-004 after PLT-001 so the shelf edit wins over the sky edit; PLT-003 starts at the paper top (y 662) and only the feather crosses it. PLT-004 stops above the note and gauge (y 862) so it cannot restore them.
build_note_v2: Stage 2 (D-096) edits are made on the stage-1 clean plate and composited onto it in this order; PLT-008 last so the desk corner wins over the shelf base.
